sections.sectionText: A hands-on exploration lab for students actively navigating academic and career possibilities. With a strong emphasis on self-awareness, self-reflection, and adaptability, students will experiment with tools and strategies to better understand how their interests, strengths, values, and goals align with potential majors and career paths. This course will be open to students living in Exploration LLC, Business LLC, and LEADS LLC during Priority Registration (Nov3-19). On Nov 20th, this section will open up to any Exploratory Studies Student living in Campus Housing. On December 3, this section will open up to all students living in Campus Housing.
